definitions.implementation_status: Offline implementation/workflow status only; implemented is not physically verified.
definitions.applicability: expected remains subject to control-level source audit; pending-audit must not be silently excluded.
definitions.completion: Every applicable feature needs source mapping, implementation, automated evidence and applicable hardware/service results.
definitions.percentage: No overall completion percentage is published while the denominator and applicability remain unresolved.

features.title: Wired USB discovery and connect
features.notes: Catalog USB VID/PID is 3151:5002. Bluetooth is 3151:5004; do not interchange them.

features.title: Bluetooth discovery and connect
features.notes: Bluetooth framing is implemented; sysfs detected Glyph at /dev/hidraw0 on 2026-09-09. root:root mode0600 prevents command verification by this user.

features.title: Macro editor/import/export
features.notes: Semantic JSON editing/import/export exists; raw exports preserve the original loaded slot. One-action capture and vendor configuration-file compatibility remain open; see the partial editor audit.

features.title: Macro delays, repeats, and playback modes
features.notes: Repeat editing and separate Keymap count/toggle/held binding controls exist. Vendor metadata and eventual library-to-assignment workflow need end-to-end comparison; physical playback remains unverified.

features.title: Mouse-motion macro semantics
features.notes: Pointers identify where to continue the audit; they are not a completed vendor comparison.

features.title: Macro recording and playback verification
features.notes: Focused keyboard and mouse-button recording support measured/fixed timing and validated draft replacement. Reserved-key workflow comparison and physical playback verification remain open. Audited vendor recorder has no continuous-motion or wheel listener.

features.title: Named macro library and local persistence
features.notes: Persistent local named entries support create, rename, update, delete, explicit editor loading and playback preferences. Revision checks protect concurrent updates. Assignment remains a separate Keymap workflow; vendor service synchronization and hardware playback are unverified.
